editorial.blurb: Shine brilliantly balances fresh sushi with authentic Shanghainese cuisine in a modern, cozy Lincoln Park corner that feels like a well-kept secret.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server about the Shanghai menu—it's the real gem here. Try the Drunken Chicken, glazed lotus roots, and scallion oil noodles for the most memorable experience, and note that seafood dishes can run pricey.
